text_block_list.text:
Симболи Рудольф and I arrive back at the
academy
after a day out.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Oh, nothing. I was just reflecting on the
day. I feel
remarkably refreshed.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
How about you? Did you enjoy cutting
loose a
little?
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф
choice_data_list: I'm just glad you had a good time.

text_block_list.text:
That's all very flattering, but it was you I
was
asking about.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Still, I do appreciate the way that you
always look
out for my well-being.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
You know, I've experimented with a lot
of
different ways of resetting myself.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Some have been effective, others less
so.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
But none have left me feeling quite so

rejuvenated as today.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Oh? Well, I'm pleased that you're so
enthusiastic.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Although I have to admit, I feel the
same.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
You know, I've experimented with a lot
of
different ways of resetting myself.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Some have been effective, others less
so.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
But none have left me feeling quite so

rejuvenated as today.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
It's gratifying to hear that Symboli
Rudolf has had
a fulfilling day off.
